The blend resists wrinkles and holds up to frequent washing, so your staff looks sharp shift after shift. Whether you need embroidered chef coats or screen-printed aprons, this fabric takes decoration cleanly and lasts. Ideal for restaurants, catering companies, and culinary schools looking for professional, long-lasting uniforms.
